description: This Java class defines the response object for a DeleteAttributes command in the Eclipse Ditto project. It encapsulates the result of deleting attributes from a thing, including serialization/deserialization methods, and contains metadata such as the thing's ID.

classes.name: DeleteAttributesResponse
classes.description: Immutable response class for handling the result of a DeleteAttributes command, including JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and string representation.

methods.name: DeleteAttributesResponse.of
methods.description: Factory method to create a DeleteAttributesResponse instance with given ThingId and headers.

methods.name: DeleteAttributesResponse.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a DeleteAttributesResponse object from a JSON string or JSON object, including headers.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId associated with this response.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer to the resource path '/attributes'.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the payload data to a JSON object builder, based on schema version and predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare based on thingId and superclass fields.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on thingId and superclass hash.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object including thingId.
